description: Replaces .github/dependabot.yml, so one bot owns dependency updates here.
Scoped to github-actions. The JVM build is build.mill, and the old Dependabot
config's note explains why it was never covered: Dependabot has no `mill`
package-ecosystem. Scala Steward handles it instead -- see .scala-steward.conf
-- and is left in place, so Renovate and Steward do not overlap.
Enroll the repo with Steward by adding it to your scala-steward-repos.md;
that instruction came from the Dependabot config and is kept here.

packageRules.description: Was the github-actions ecosystem in .github/dependabot.yml: weekly, labels dependencies + github-actions. Grouped into one PR, which Dependabot was not doing.
